At load the gate marks it, so resting padding and gaps are 0, `580 <= 600` holds, teardown runs and the bar stays a wrapped static block. The same happens when the items fit only because gaps are ignored. The tests in `tests/js/fx-marquee.test.js` call `mount()` with no pre-mark, so none of the gate path is covered (negative control missing). | no |
